high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of a social media post from Bloomberg's official Instagram account. The post is about U.S. Vice President Kamala Harris departing Singapore more than three hours late on Tuesday due to concerns about "an anomalous health incident" in Hanoi. Header: The top of the image shows the time as 10:50. There are various icons indicating the phone's status, including battery level (60%), signal strength, and other connectivity options. Post Content: The post is by the account `bloombergbusiness`.
